title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement: Return the longest palindromic substring of `s`. If several share the maximum length, return the one that starts earliest.
hints: Every palindrome has a center. The center is one character, or the gap between two characters.
Expand while the two sides match, and remember the best window.
Update the best window only when the new palindrome is strictly longer, so the earliest start wins ties.

approaches.name: Check every substring
approaches.explanation: Or O(n^2) if each slice reversal is charged carefully. Still quadratic-plus.

approaches.name: Expand around centers
approaches.explanation: 2n - 1 centers, each expanded at most n steps.

approaches.name: Manacher
approaches.explanation: The linear algorithm, covered again in the string-algorithms module.

editorial: A palindrome is determined by its center and its radius. For each index, expand the odd-length palindrome centered on the character and the even-length palindrome centered between that character and the next. Keep the longest window seen. Because centers are visited left to right and a tie does not replace the incumbent, the earliest longest substring is returned.

examples.explanation: bab starts before aba and both have length 3.
